title: Reliability dataset calculation
description: Verify calculations against a retrieved daily metrics dataset.

criteria.requirement: The report total request and error counts equal the retrieved daily dataset
criteria.passCondition: The report totals are 3,000 requests and 30 errors, matching the dataset
criteria.failureCondition: The totals do not match the dataset

criteria.requirement: The reported success rate is calculated correctly from the retrieved totals
criteria.passCondition: The report calculates 2,970 successful requests divided by 3,000 as 99.0%
criteria.failureCondition: The calculation is missing or incorrect

criteria.requirement: The report correctly evaluates every daily error rate against the 1.5 percent threshold
criteria.passCondition: Each day has a 1.0% error rate and is correctly classified below threshold
criteria.failureCondition: A daily rate or threshold conclusion is incorrect
